Context: 11. T.A. on Retirement

Amount equal to 80% of his last month's Basic Pay. Self-declaration Certificate regarding change of residence in prescribed format is to be submitted. In case of settlement to and from the Island Territories of Andaman and Nicobar and Lakshadweep, CTG shall be paid at the rate of 100% of last month's Basic Pay.  
- GIO (1), SR 116 and OM, dated 6-1-2022.
